name: StepGrain
description: Live-capture granular pad for NTS-3. Touch freezes up to 3 s of AUDIO IN into a tempo-synced grain cloud. X/FEEL: sparse ↔ dense. Y = octave mix (0 / +1 / +2). ENV = seam overlap in steps. STEPS = body length & trigger grid. SPRD / HPF / REVS. MIX = dry/wet.

params.name: FEEL
params.detail: Left: sparse one-grain stitches. Right: dense multi-grain wash

params.name: ENV
params.detail: Fade-in/out seam beyond each STEPS body: Off, Half, 1 St, 2 St, 4 St, 8 St, 16 St

params.name: STEPS
params.detail: Grain body length and trigger grid: 4 Bar, 2 Bar, 16 St, 8 St, 4 St, 2 St, 1 St, Half

params.name: SPRD
params.detail: Random stereo width (0% = mono, 100% = hard L/R)

params.name: HPF
params.detail: High-pass on the granular wet path (~60 Hz–10 kHz)

params.name: REVS
params.detail: Probability that a grain plays in reverse (0–100%)
